philippines.title: PBA: Converge reaches first semifinals after ousting Rain or Shine
philippines.description:
SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Converge secured its first-ever PBA semifinal appearance after finishing off Rain or Shine, 120-109, in Game 4 of their 2026 Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series on Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Back-to-back triples from Mikey Williams proved to be the decisive moment that enabled the FiberXers to finally produce a breakthrough moment for the franchise that has been in the league since 2022. Williams gave Converge a 115-107 lead with 2:42 left in the fourth, ending any hopes of Rain or Shine forcing a deciding fifth game. The FiberXers ended a string of quarterfinal heartbreaks […]...

philippines.title: Alex Eala outlasts Antonia Ruzic to reach Hong Kong Open semifinals
philippines.description:
LIVE: Alex Eala vs Antonia Ruzic – Hong Kong Open quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala survived another grueling battle in the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open, beating Antonia Ruzic of Croatia, 7-6 (7), 7-5, on Friday to advance to the semifinals. Eala battled through another lengthy tiebreak for the second night in a row, then rallied in the second set after losing a 4-2 lead to wrap up the match in two hours, 30 minutes. energy.title: Energy Aspects Slashes Forecast of China’s November Diesel Exports
energy.description: Reduced domestic inventories will likely result in significantly lower Chinese exports of diesel in November amid the global diesel crisis, analysts at Energy Aspects say as they slashed their estimates of Chinese shipments this month. Energy Aspects now sees China’s diesel exports at about 580,000 tons in November, down by 400,000 tons from the previous assessment, according to a note carried by Bloomberg. However, there could be upward revisions to the new forecast as refiners may ramp up shipments if domestic demand starts to drop off…
